data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'b-h-y', meaning 'to brighten' or 'to shine'. This name conveys the idea of a radiant and luminous spirit, reflecting the light of faith and wisdom. The name Bahiy carries the meaning “Shining, Bright” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahiy usually hope their child will grow to embody shining, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
